How we know

Robert rides it every Friday. On Oct 8, 2026 he confirmed the 7:00 am start at the shop, the Paradise Valley loop to La Grande Orange, about 20 miles, social and no-drop. ENVE’s profile of the shop names its Friday Ride; the shop’s own site doesn’t post a schedule.

Hosted by
Bicycle HaüsBike shop
Kind of ride
Road

For visitors

It ends at La Grande Orange (4410 N 40th St, Phoenix), not back at the shop. Plan your own way home from there.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 7:00 am. Tell whoever’s leading that you’re new.
Pace
Social. Nobody gets dropped. It’s no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That’s the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @bicyclehaus the day of — that’s where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

First group ride? Start here →

About the Friday Shop Ride group ride

Friday Shop Ride is a road group ride in Scottsdale, AZ. It rolls every Friday at 7:00 am from Bicycle Haüs.

Bicycle Haüs’s Friday morning shop ride. It rolls from the shop in Old Town Scottsdale at 7:00 am, loops around Paradise Valley and finishes at La Grande Orange in Arcadia, about 20 miles. Social and no-drop.
